original_question: Suppose that φ is an automorphism of a finite soluble group G. Must G contain a subgroup of index bounded in terms of |φ| and |CG(φ)| whose Fitting height is bounded(a) in terms of |φ|? (b) or even in terms of the composition length of ⟨φ⟩? An affirmative answer to part(b) is known when |φ| is a prime power(B. Hartley– V. Turau), or when(|G|, |φ|) = 1(A. Turull, B. Hartley–I. M. Isaacs). Also cf. 19.43.
target_in_paper: Problem 21.65 in the 21st issue ("New Problems"): the bounded-index subgroup question for a single automorphism φ of a finite soluble group, with Fitting height bounded either by |φ| alone or by the composition length of ⟨φ⟩.
correct_elements: Your draft matches the paper's official formulation almost verbatim. It correctly identifies the setting of a finite soluble group G with an automorphism φ, asks for a subgroup of G of index bounded in terms of |φ| and |C_G(φ)|, keeps the paper's two-part split between bounds depending only on |φ| and bounds depending on the composition length of ⟨φ⟩, and includes exactly the same known positive cases and the cross-reference to 19.43.
missing_details: Define C_G(φ) explicitly as the fixed-point subgroup {g in G : φ(g) = g}.
Make the quantifiers explicit: for every finite soluble group G and every automorphism φ of G, does there exist a subgroup H ≤ G with the stated properties?
Spell out that the bounded index is [G : H], and that this index bound depends only on |φ| and |C_G(φ)|.
Clarify that in both parts (a) and (b), the Fitting-height bound is for the subgroup H, not for G itself.
Clarify that 'bounded in terms of' means bounded above by some function of the indicated parameters only.
If you want the question fully stand-alone, say that the composition length is taken for the finite cyclic group ⟨φ⟩.
refined_question: For every finite soluble group G and every automorphism φ of G, where C_G(φ) = {g in G : φ(g) = g}, must there exist a subgroup H ≤ G such that [G : H] is bounded by a function of |φ| and |C_G(φ)|, and such that the Fitting height h(H) is bounded either (a) by a function of |φ| alone, or even (b) by a function of the composition length of the cyclic group ⟨φ⟩ alone?
justification: The draft is targeting Problem 21.65, not the earlier Problem 19.43. The wording of 21.65 matches your draft almost exactly, including the two subparts, the prime-power and coprime known cases, and the explicit cross-reference 'Also cf. 19.43'. The nearby Problems 21.66 and 21.67 show that the paper treats separately the variant for a nilpotent automorphism group A and the variant where one bounds in terms of the Prüfer rank of C_G(φ), so the sharpened question should stay with a single automorphism φ and the bounded-index subgroup formulation. Problem 19.43 is only related background: it asks instead whether the Fitting height of G itself is bounded in terms of |φ| and |C_G(φ)|.
